notes.legacy_invoice_only_types: These payment-link or pre-QR overage events are retained only for compatibility detection. The current Swiss invoice-only flow must use invoice_email and the QR invoice PDF instead.
notes.contract_signed_email: A PDF is attached when contract.signed_pdf_url is available; otherwise the signed page link remains the fallback.
notes.call_notification_email: Replaces the notification half of Make scenario 01, which sent through its own SMTP module past the outbox. The payload keeps scenario 01's field names (caller_name, caller_phone, call_summary, category, lead_quality, duration_seconds) so its HTML template transplants into scenario 09 unchanged; only the recipient moves from the resolver response into the nested recipient.email that every other mail type already uses.
notes.callback_request_email: The callback_requested branch of the same path. Split into its own mail_type because it carries a different template than call_notification_email.
notes.call_notification_gating: Which of the two types fires is decided by decideMail() in customer-dashboard/netlify/functions/_lib/call-notification.js. It reads customers.notification_mode (none | callback_only | all_calls) -- the only column the customer settings page writes. The interim state described during the migration (gating on the legacy booleans notification_active / new_log_email_active for behaviour parity with Make scenario 01) has been replaced by the notification-settings work as the agreed follow-up step. The Make routes are unaffected either way: scenario 09 filters on mail_type only, and both types stayed the same.
notes.ai_change_request: recipient.email added 2026-08-11 (#900): ai-change-request-create.js has sent it nested since admin_notification_settings replaced the shared mailbox, but this manifest and scenario 09's route 7 module 52 'to' field (which read the flat, nonexistent 1.admin_email) were never updated to match -- every notification silently went to the fallback info@voxera.ch regardless of the admin's selection. Documentation only: no runtime code enforces required_payloads for this mail_type, only verify-call-notification-migration.mjs does, and only for the two call-notification types.
